purpose: Background signin-time probe that runs once per 24h after the MarmotProvider init path completes. Detects uninspected kind-1059 gift-wrap invitations by comparing network wrap count against failed-welcome records and loaded groups, then surfaces an inline banner if a material gap is found.

public_api.name: MarmotContextValue.probeBannerCount
public_api.description: 0 = no banner; >0 = show banner with this count of potentially undelivered invitations

public_api.name: MarmotProvider
public_api.signature: function MarmotProvider({ signer, pubkey, relays, children }: MarmotProviderProps): JSX.Element
public_api.description: Existing provider, extended to run the probe after setState({ loading: false }) and render an inline aria-live='polite' banner when probeBannerCount > 0

owned_data: notestr-identity IDB key 'lastProbeAt' (shared store, probe-owned key)
dependencies_forbidden: Direct idb-keyval imports without going through storage.ts for new stores
Any module outside src/marmot/ or src/config/
external_ports: client.network.request(DEFAULT_RELAYS, [{kinds:[1059], '#p':[pubkey], since}], {timeout:10000}) — kind-1059 gift wrap fetch
test_targets: lastProbeAt absent → probe runs, lastProbeAt set in IDB
lastProbeAt fresh (< 24h ago) → probe does NOT run, lastProbeAt NOT updated
probeBannerCount set when wrapCount > failedCount + groupCount
probeBannerCount stays 0 when wrapCount <= failedCount + groupCount
